'''Abd-Allah ibn Numayr''' (died 199 AH/814) was a [[narrators of hadith|narrator of hadith]].

==Name==
His full name was al-[[Hafiz (Qur'an)|Hafiz]] [[Muhammad (name)|Muhammad]] [[Abd-Allah (name)|Abdallah]] ibn Numayr al-Hamdani.

==Legacy==
He has been quoted in [[Sahih Muslim]]<ref>{{hadith-usc|usc=yes|muslim|8|3266}} includes him, although the USC-MSA Compendium of Muslim Texts does not include the entire isnad of the hadith.</ref> and by [[Maxime Rodinson]].<ref>[http://www.fordham.edu/halsall/med/rodinson.html Rodinson. Muhammad<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>

===Sunni view===
[[Ibn Hajar Asqalani]] is quoted in [[Tahdhib al-Tahdhib]]<ref>[http://www.al-islam.org/thaqalayn/nontl/Notes17-217.htm Notes<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> that '''Abd-Allah ibn Numayr''' has been considered [[wikt:veracious|veracious]] (Arabic: ''[[thiqah]]'') by [[Yahya ibn Ma'in]], [[al-Ijli]] and [[Ibn Sa'd]].<ref name="thaqalayn">[http://www.al-islam.org/ Al-islam.org] [http://www.al-islam.org/thaqalayn/nontl/Nar0-2.htm]</ref>
